packageRules.description: Defer Backstage major upgrades — done as dedicated, tested rollouts (deploy + verify on labul), not auto PRs
Stay on React 18 for Backstage compatibility — defer the React 19 major, and react-router majors that require React 19 (v8 needs react >=19.2.7, #153)
Defer isolated-vm major — native module (scaffolder), needs image build + scaffolder verification
Defer TypeScript 7 (the Go-native compiler) — the Backstage tooling crashes on it in yarn tsc ('useCaseSensitiveFileNames', #148)

Hold the Dagger engine on v0.20.x — v0.21's llbtodagger rejects packages/backend/Dockerfile ('mkdir without makeParents is unsupported', #98, #145). Lift together with the Dockerfile fix and the module bump (#140)
